name: mtp-v2-active-position-local-topk-topp

inactive_prior_candidate.reason: Native V2 MTP does not invoke llm_base_proposer.py; prior V2 serving arms with that layer must be interpreted as inactive-patch/control.

files.port_type: behavioral adaptation to active native V2 MTP, not direct V1 cherry-pick
behavioral adaptation to active native V2 MTP, not direct V1 cherry-pick

port_deviations: Only MTPSpeculator overrides the native probabilistic helper; shared and non-MTP speculators are unchanged.
Runner binds final SamplingStates owner after sampler/custom-sampler initialization, before warmup/capture.
Persistent device top-k/top-p vectors refresh from rotating UVA views in _copy_request_inputs outside replay; captured code never reads rotating UVA filter pointers.
FP32 promotion occurs before temperature division, preserving actual native V2 Gumbel numerical semantics for BF16/FP16 heads.
Greedy temperature==0 and padded -1 rows use neutral filters; request-state indices support reordering/repetition and top-k is bounded by actual draft vocabulary.
Native seeded Gumbel stream and stored filtered-logit q cache are preserved; apply_temperature=False prevents double scaling.

excluded_upstream.reason: Baseline lacks apply_top_k_top_p_probs insertion API; native V2 rejection reconstructs q from cached logits, so extra probability-helper refactoring is unnecessary.

unchanged_contracts: Existing probabilistic draft enablement and MTP depth, sampler defaults, backend feature gates, model/quantization and parser/cache contracts.
Per-request/position-keyed native draft Gumbel seeds, draft_gumbel_pos separation, FP32/FP64 noise choice and rejection RNG keys.
Cached processed logits are stored before noise, with original scalar/per-row draft columns and active/invalid-row guards.
History-dependent processors and min_p remain target-only; target sampler and rejection kernels are unchanged.
Non-probabilistic MTP allocates no new filter vectors and retains its original greedy sampling route.

coverage: Exact installed candidate/dependency hashes and required CUDA/Triton dispatch.
FP32/BF16/FP16 logits with FP32/FP64 native seeded noise; small and >=8-row batches.
Independent constrained-probability oracle, original greedy tied argmax and native seeded replay.
Request-major repeated slots, reordered indices, padded -1 and stale-valid inactive rows, unaddressed cache cells.
Real CUDA graph replay across four rotating-UVA/filter updates, reused request-state temperature/seed, reordered rows and changed active-row count.
Native rejection q reconstruction across multiple 8192-wide tiles, explicitly including all--inf q tiles for top-k1 and tiny nucleus.
Native p=q acceptance and deterministic disjoint-support rejection/recovery.
limitations: CPU mode validates exact preprocessing/copy logic and probabilities only, returning at the CUDA Gumbel boundary; not native kernel proof.
CUDA mode exercises real native kernels and sampling graphs but loads no model/engine; full runner binding, DCP and serving behavior require Main runtime experiments.
No runtime execution, build, formatter, linter, tests, performance or memory-margin measurements performed by this worker.
validation.main_note: Removed a redundant sum(softmax(logits)) normalization assertion that failed on ordinary FP32 reduction rounding at8193 vocabulary; independent support/probability oracle and finite checks remain. Production source unchanged.
